run_sweep_forward: run the benchmark sweep forward from the last known commit to HEAD
run_sweep_forward_n_commits: run the benchmark sweep forward across exactly N commits
run_sweep_back: run the benchmark sweep backward from the earliest known commit to root
run_sweep_mock: run the benchmark sweep in mock mode for fast testing with nworld=1 and nstep=10
run_sweep_filter: run the benchmark sweep forward filtering benchmarks by name with a regex pattern
